scope: Static code review and saved-artifact checks of the Round 5 model exploration.
reviewer_role: Review of the TabPFN runner and ensemble implementation.
overall_finding: No blocking leakage, target-inverse, or component-path issue identified in the reviewed source and executed checks.

static_checks.evidence: run_candidate creates a fresh model per fold, fits X.iloc[tr]/target[tr], and predicts X.iloc[va]. Each fit uses only its training partition.
load_data only normalizes object/null representations globally; learned internal preprocessing is fitted through each model.fit on its training subset.
Box-Cox power and $100000 scale are fixed constants; computing the rowwise transform before splitting learns no target statistics. The inverse returns natural-log prices.
Official test file has no SalePrice. Training labels come only from data/raw/train.csv; checkpoint hashes are checked against the retained public model manifest.

Means, medians and equal log-space mixtures are distinct predictive summaries. Inverting the mean in Box-Cox space need not equal the mean in log space; this is an ablation, not an algebraic equivalence claim.
Round5 runner rejects the three overriding thread environment variables and sets torch threads to12. Replay wrapper removes those variables in each child; legacy helper uses recorded/default12.

Repeated seed42 development folds and public-score-guided selection are disclosed. Six calibrator-only crossfits use saved base OOF predictions and remain supplementary to the primary experiment integration.

executed_checks.transform_inverse_source_execution: Exact AST-extracted transform_y and to_log_prices functions; no Torch import or model fit.

nonblocking_limitations: comparison.csv contains only the candidates selected in the latest invocation; use the per-candidate summary JSON files for the complete experiment inventory.

The runner explicitly asserts finite primary vectors, while secondary median vectors rely on subsequent computations. This audit separately verified all currently completed secondary OOF and test vectors are finite; the delivery promotion script also validates integrated vectors.
Reproducibility across a different Torch/TabPFN version or hardware backend is not established; use the locked local environment and saved numerical tolerance.
Static inspection does not independently audit the internals of pretrained weights or certify their entire training corpus.
